title: Crispy French Pan-Fried Chicken
description: A simple and delicious French dish made with pan-fried chicken and crispy fries. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: 1. Slice the chicken into thin cutlets.
2. Season with salt and fry spice.
3. In a pan, heat the mixed veg oil over medium heat.
4. Add the chicken to the pan and cook until golden brown.
5. Flip the chicken and cook the other side until cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, cook the fries according to package instructions.
7. Serve the chicken with fries and enjoy!
8. Garnish with your favorite herbs if desired.
